# AI Capacity-Building Action Plan for Good and for All

Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC (MFA), updated September 27, 2024. Full text retrieved.

## Key findings
- To bridge the AI and digital divides — especially to help the **Global South** benefit equitably — China proposes the **AI Capacity-Building Action Plan for Good and for All**, upholding the UN's central/coordinating role, true multilateralism, implementing UNGA Resolution A/RES/78/311 (Enhancing International Cooperation on Capacity-Building of AI) and the UN 2030 Agenda, via North-South, South-South, and triangular cooperation, on principles of sovereign equality, development orientation, people-centred, shared benefits, inclusiveness, and multi-party coordination.
- **Vision and Goals (5)**:
  1. Promote AI and Digital Infrastructure Connectivity (improve global layout/interoperability; help Global South access AI).
  2. Empower Industries Through the "AI Plus" Application (industrial manufacturing, traditional agriculture, green transition, climate change response, biodiversity conservation).
  3. Enhance AI Literacy and Strengthen Personnel Training (AI in education, exchange/training of AI professionals, protect/strengthen digital and AI rights of women and children).
  4. Improve AI Data Security and Diversity (orderly/free cross-border data flow per law; explore global data-sharing platform; promote equality/diversity in AI datasets to eliminate racism/discrimination/algorithmic bias; preserve cultural diversity).
  5. Ensure AI Safety, Reliability and Controllability (fairness/nondiscrimination; global interoperable AI risk-assessment frameworks/standards/governance under the UN; joint risk assessment; ensure AI contributes to human well-being).
- **China's Actions**: engage all countries on AI capacity-building (North-South/South-South/triangular; implement UN Summit of the Future outcomes; jointly develop AI infrastructure, build joint laboratories); cooperate on AI model R&D and empowering applications (poverty reduction, healthcare, agriculture, education, industrial manufacturing); tap AI potential in green development/climate/biodiversity; establish an international cooperation platform for AI capacity-building; **hold short and medium-term AI capacity-building programs for fellow developing countries, share AI education resources, jointly carry out AI education/exchange programs**; **hold 10 AI workshops and seminars primarily aimed at fellow developing countries by the end of 2025** (building on the first Workshop on AI Capacity-Building that year); promote AI literacy (focus on digital rights of women and children); develop AI language/data resources (eliminate racial/algorithmic/cultural discrimination); develop/improve data infrastructure; synergize AI strategies and share testing/evaluation/certification/regulation practices.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — primary/official: MFA publishes the full text of China's AI Capacity-Building Action Plan.
